title: Superolateral approach
view: Right knee and lower thigh from the front, patient supine: thigh at the top, lateral on the image left, medial on the right.
teachingPoint: Enter 1 cm superior and 1 cm lateral to the patella's superolateral pole and aim medially, under the patella, into the suprapatellar recess.
claims: Right knee from the front, lateral on the image left (house laterality).
Purple dot: the patella's superolateral pole.
Teal: a 7 mm insertion zone 1 cm lateral and 1 cm superior to that pole (record; the zone size is drawn, not from the record).
Arrow: the needle aimed medially, under the patella (record).
Dashed teal: the suprapatellar recess above the patella, under the quadriceps tendon (standard anatomy, drawn about 4.4 cm wide and 5.5 cm deep).
Labels: Insertion site, 1 cm superior, 1 cm lateral, Patella, Suprapatellar recess.

geometry.why: insertion is superior to the patella
the recess lies above the patella
the needle runs from the insertion site
the arrow ends under the patella
